Your records

Where your records live, how to keep a copy, how to take everything out, and how to leave. The records are yours; the app holds them in trust.

Where records live

What it is

Everything you enter is saved on this phone first. With an account, you choose what also goes to your private cloud: section by section, nothing, only what you pick, or everything. Removing something from the cloud never deletes it from this phone.

Also inNothing gets lostRecords you can trust

Step 1 · Choose what goes to the cloud

Signed in, open Account. Under Cloud sync, each section (Origin, Roasts, Cup) has Off, Selected and All. Off keeps it on this phone. Selected sends only the records you tap Save to cloud on. All sends every record you save. Each section shows how many records are in the cloud.

Also inNothing gets lostGetting set up

What it is

Signed in, the top of Account shows your email and how many roasts are in the cloud, your backup reminder, Make it yours, and Sign out.

Also inGetting set up

Keep a copy

Step 2 · Save a copy of everything

Open My data (from Account, or from the person button). Tap Export everything for one file with all your records. Save / Share archive sends it through the phone's share sheet to Files, Drive, Dropbox or a computer.

Try it in the app ›

Also inNothing gets lost

Step 3 · Bring my records back on a new phone

On the new phone, open My data and tap Import, then pick the file you saved.

Try it in the app ›

Also inNothing gets lost

Step 4 · Set how often I am reminded to back up

On Account, Backup reminder sets how often Now reminds you: every few weeks (standard), weekly, after each save, or off.

Try it in the app ›

Also inNothing gets lost

Step 5 · Export a list for a spreadsheet

Most lists have Export for CSV (Excel or Google Sheets) or JSON: Origin, Cup, the Roastbook and the Map. Roasts also go out as Artisan and Cropster files, plots as GeoJSON and KML.

Also inNothing gets lostRecords you can trust

Share and show

Step 6 · See everything I have recorded

Tap the round person button on any page for Me: totals for what you have grown, processed, roasted and brewed, a chart for the last 12 months, and your recent records. Profile makes a one-page profile with your name, logo and colour; save it as PDF or publish a link.

Try it in the app ›

Also inFinding your way

Step 7 · Share a record as an image

Open a plot, harvest, run or green lot and tap Image or PDF: an Instagram post, a story or a PDF, drawn on your phone with your profile name, logo and colour. Notes and GPS location are left out unless you switch them on.

Try it in the app ›

Also inOne coffee, one chain

Step 8 · Pick records from a list

On a list in Origin, tap Select, then tap the records you want. A bar shows how many are picked, with All shown and All records beside the Image or PDF button. Tap Done when you have finished.

Try it in the app ›

Also inFinding your wayNothing gets lost

Step 9 · Narrow a list

Tap Filter to narrow a list. For harvests the boxes are estate, variety, plot, picking style, dates, Brix and ripeness, and where the record is stored. Clear filters shows everything again, and the line under the list counts what is shown.

Try it in the app ›

Also inFinding your way

Photos of what you read

Step 10 · Keep a photo of a label, a scale or a screen

Open Capture. Choose what you are capturing, such as a bag label, a scale, a probe display or a roast colour. Add a photo with Camera, Photos or Files, then type the value, unit and label you read from it. Nothing is recorded until you tap Confirm & record. Discard clears it.

Try it in the app ›

Also inNothing gets lost

Leaving

Step 11 · Remove my records from this phone

On My data, export first, then Delete local KoffyKraft data removes them from this phone.

Try it in the app ›

Also inNothing gets lost

Step 12 · Delete my account

On Account, open Delete my account. Save a backup file first. Choose the Wait before deleting (24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or 30 days) and tap Email me a deletion code. Entering the code deletes your account and all your cloud records after the wait; you can cancel until then. What is on this phone stays until you clear it.

Watch out

Published passports stay readable for the buyers who hold them, even after you delete your account. Ask KoffyKraft to take your name off them.

Also inRecords you can trust

What it is

The privacy notice says what is kept, for how long, and what happens to your records if KoffyKraft closes. You agree to it when you first sign in.
